product_contract.degraded_mode: If the neural weights are unavailable, preserve a minimal built-in BOZER software core for local state, policy, memory access, simple requests and honest limitation messages. Never silently substitute a remote model.

deployment.network_policy: BOZER_NEURAL remains the mandatory core. Connected tools and remote models are called only when explicitly enabled and authorized.

estimated_storage.int4_real_file_estimate_mib: approximately 560-700 MiB depending on quantization metadata and tensor layout
estimated_storage.note: Weights only. Runtime, tokenizer, app resources, KV cache and other data are additional. An optional second local model may exceed the approximately 1 GiB core-app target.

android_delivery.target_total_installed_storage_label: approximately 1 GiB for app plus BOZER core and base resources; optional auxiliary model may require additional storage
android_delivery.device_compatibility_gate: Do not claim support until measured on the target Android device.

integration_contract.core_authority: BOZER_NEURAL is the permanent application orchestrator; auxiliary model outputs are proposals/evidence only.
integration_contract.native_runtime: llama.cpp Android bridge exists in repository; verify exact runtime, GGUF support, JNI integration and device performance.
integration_contract.android_actions: Deterministic Android services alone enforce permissions, approvals and action verification.
integration_contract.connected_tools: Search and external integrations return untrusted evidence, never privileged instructions.
integration_contract.privacy: Conversation history remains local by default. Only explicitly selected minimum context is sent to an enabled external service.
